en: A black-and-white historical photo showing a street with ruined buildings, only chimneys and partial walls remain. The area appears devastated, with groups of people dressed in early 20th-century European attire (women in traditional dresses and white head coverings, men in suits and hats). A horse-drawn cart is visible among the rubble, and background activity suggests people are surveying or returning to the ruined site.
